warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for Lower West, South West
warnings.desc: HEAVY RAINFALL which may lead to FLASH FLOODING is possible about parts of the South West and Lower West districts early on Wednesday morning. Six-hourly rainfall totals between 30 and 60 mm are expected, with possible localised falls up to 70 mm. Heavy falls are expected to ease during the early evening. Locations which may be affected include Bunbury, Mandurah, Collie, Harvey, Dwellingup and Pinjarra.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Riverina
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce large hailstones, damaging winds and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours.
